title: Verify that the user is able to login successfully with valid credentials
precondition: User is on the login page
steps: Launch browser and navigate to Sauce Demo URL
expected_result: User is redirected to Products page and inventory items are displayed

title: Verify that login is denied for locked out user
precondition: User is on the login page
expected_result: Error message displayed: "Sorry, this user has been locked out."

title: Verify that login fails with invalid username
precondition: User is on the login page
expected_result: Error message: "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service"

title: Verify that login fails with invalid password
precondition: User is on the login page
expected_result: Error message: "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service"

title: Verify that login fails when username is empty
precondition: User is on the login page
expected_result: Error message: "Epic sadface: Username is required"

title: Verify that login fails when password is empty
precondition: User is on the login page
expected_result: Error message: "Epic sadface: Password is required"

title: Verify that login fails when both fields are empty
precondition: User is on the login page
steps: Leave both username and password empty
expected_result: Error message: "Epic sadface: Username is required"

title: Verify error message is displayed for performance glitch user
precondition: User is on the login page
expected_result: Login succeeds but page may load slowly or show glitch behavior
